fullPassage: Students often mistake familiarity with true mastery, creating a dangerous "illusion of competence" where recognizing information feels like genuine knowledge, but they struggle when asked to recall or apply it independently. This cognitive bias, strengthened by passive study methods, leads learners to overestimate their understanding. Ultimately, __________ transforms surface familiarity into real mastery, exposing and filling gaps in knowledge and ensuring solid, reliable understanding.
